questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(13, 234, 9)

(15, 180, 6)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
**The logic followed here is:** (1st number × 3rd number × 2) = 2nd number

(13, 234, 9)

13 × 9 × 2 = 234

234 = 234 (LHS = RHS)

And,

(15, 180, 6)

15 × 6 × 2 = 180

180 = 180 (LHS = RHS)

So, checking each option one by one

Option 1) (14, 196, 7)

14 × 7 × 2 = 196

**196 = 196 (LHS = RHS)**

Option 2) (12, 108, 9)

12 × 9 × 2 = 108

216 ≠ 108 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) (16, 240, 5)

16 × 5 × 2 = 240

160 ≠ 240 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 4) (17, 340, 5)

17 × 5 × 2 = 340

170 ≠ 340 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Thus, out of all the options '(14, 196, 7)' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:

questions.solution:

⇒ **28 : 729**

⇒ (28 - 1)² = (27)² = 729.

Similarly,

⇒ **32 : ?**

⇒ (32 - 1)² = (31)² = **961**

Hence, the correct answer is **"961".**

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given set.

(**NOTE:** Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the number into its constituent digits.E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /Subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(25, 150, 3)

(18, 180, 5)

Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

15 : 125 :: 27 : ? :: 36 : 1728

Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(6, 9, 45)
questions.solution:
The logic is:

**(1st number + second number) × (2nd number - 1st number) = third number**

(6, 9, 45) → (6 + 9) × (9 - 6) = 15 × 3 = 45

Similarly,

(8, 10, 36) → (8 + 10) × (10 - 8) = 18 × 2 = 36

Hence, ‘**(8, 10, 36) **’ is the correct answer.
